balanced.description: Symmetric baseline traffic: 0.35 cars/sec across all North, South, East, West gates (oversaturated, queues grow over time).

moderate_load.description: Uncongested baseline: 0.18 cars/sec per gate (~108 cars/min offered load, ~75-80% of measured network capacity).

directional_moderate.description: Lopsided bounded demand: W/E gates 0.30 cars/s, N/S gates 0.10 cars/s (~75-85% saturation, tests split adaptation without severe overload).

incident_moderate.description: Moderate arrival rates (0.18 cars/s) plus lane reduction on Link 1->2 (Saidapet to Nandanam) from t=100s to t=400s.

shifting_demand.description: W/E gates 0.30 and N/S gates 0.10 for t < 300s, then swapped (W/E 0.10, N/S 0.30) for t >= 300s (moderate total load).

surge_moderate.description: Moderate baseline (0.18) with a 3x burst (0.54) at East-West gates between t=200s and t=300s.

rush_hour.description: Lopsided heavy demand: East-West arterial gates (W, E) receive 3x traffic (0.45 cars/s) vs cross-streets (0.15 cars/s).

surge_accident.description: Arterial surge (0.45 W/E, 0.20 N/S) + active incident on Link 1->2 (Saidapet to Nandanam) between t=50s and t=250s.
